newsitem.title: CHINA: China freight traffic volume down in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: China freight traffic volume down in Jan-May.

text.p: China's freight traffic volume in the first five months of this year dropped to 1.1 billion tonnes, down 1.4 percent compared with the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
Railway freight traffic was 668 million tonnes, down 1.1 percent year-on-year, Xinhua said quoting figures from the State Statistical Bureau.
Road freight in January-May was 177 million tonnes, down 2.7 percent year-on-year while air cargo was 488,000 tonnes, up eight percent year-on-year, the agency said.
In the same period, passenger traffic rose to 2.1 billion persons, up 4.3 percent compared with the same period last year, it said.
Road passengers totalled 1.65 billion persons, up 6.7 percent year-on-year, while those travelling by air rose 5.5 percent to 22.67 million persons, it said.
However, railway passenger volume fell 3.8 percent year-on-year to 386 million, it said.
